satellite: UNKNOWN (bands provided pre-processed, no STAC query performed)
cloud_percentage: UNKNOWN (no SCL/QA layer provided; only nodata masking applied)
sampling_strategy: equal_count, 3000 samples/class, spatial block split (300m blocks, 25% test)
cloud_shadow_masking: UNAVAILABLE — no SCL/QA layer provided with the Sentinel-2 bands

spatial_cleanup.method: isolated-pixel-only: reclassify center only if ALL 8 neighbors are valid and unanimously agree on one different class; never touches NoData; does not apply a general mode filter (protects small legitimate features).

important_note: All evaluation metrics measure agreement with ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 reference labels (a global reference product, ~76.7% independently validated accuracy), NOT field-verified ground truth. Full-scene predicted class percentages should not be read as area estimates without accounting for the known equal-count-sampling class prior distortion documented in outputs/experiment_comparison.json.
known_limitations: Built-up is over-predicted relative to WorldCover reference prevalence.
Barren is over-predicted relative to WorldCover reference prevalence.
Water <-> Barren confusion exists because of heterogeneous reference labeling.
36/66 micro-watersheds have LOW or INSUFFICIENT_DATA coverage.
Only one Sentinel-2 date is currently used.
WorldCover is reference/pseudo-ground-truth and is not field-verified.
